## Errors

- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/errors/overview): Troubleshooting is an important part of integrating with the PayPal Orders API.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/errors/validation-error): You get a validation error when the API request contains invalid, missing, or incorrectly formatted data.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/errors/resource-not-found): A `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` error occurs when the specified resource does not exist. The following issues can cause this error.
